title: Desenvolvedor(a) OutSystems
description:
VAGA ABERTA: Desenvolvedor(a) OutSystems Pleno – Remoto


Em busca de uma carreira em uma empresa que valoriza a flexibilidade, desenvolvimento pessoal e sucesso da equipe? Com 28 anos de experiência e reconhecidos pelo GPTW pelo quinto ano consecutivo, estamos em busca de talentos para se juntarem a nós como Desenvolvedor(a) OutSystems . Com matriz no Brasil e filiais em território internacional, oferecemos oportunidades para crescimento e desenvolvimento. Candidate-se agora e faça parte de uma equipe que transforma negócios e realiza sonhos!


Requisitos essenciais:


  • Graduação em curso superior na área de TI, ou graduação em qualquer área acompanhada de pós-graduação (especialização, mestrado ou doutorado) em TI com carga mínima de 360 horas;
  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações OutSystems;
  • Domínio de boas práticas de codificação;
  • Capacidade de analisar logs, identificar e corrigir erros.


Requisitos adicionais:


  • Raciocínio lógico apurado e facilidade para compreender regras de negócio;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados como SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, entre outros;
  • Conhecimento prático em linguagens web, como JavaScript, CSS e HTML5;
  • Compreensão de modelagem de banco de dados;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de inteligência artificial, como ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, plataformas de geração de imagens ou automação de processos, aplicadas a: Automatização de tarefas, criação de relatórios e análise de dados, apoio à tomada de decisão e inovação contínua, melhoria da eficiência operacional e qualidade das entregas.


Responsabilidades:


  • Executar as tarefas do backlog conforme priorização do Product Owner (PO) ou Responsável Técnico;
  • Distribuir as tarefas priorizadas do backlog entre os membros da equipe;
  • Interagir com o cliente em caso de dúvidas ou para obter feedback sobre o software desenvolvido;
  • Participar das reuniões convocadas pelo Facilitador;
  • Realizar a quebra das histórias priorizadas em atividades;
  • Manter o quadro de tarefas atualizado;
  • Desenvolver o produto ou sistema.


Nossos cuidados com você:

*Benefícios a variar de acordo com a modalidade de contrato


Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição Ifood Empresas;

Benefício indireto (valor fixo para custeio parcial do plano de saúde ou somado ao vale alimentação);

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Sys Manager - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Auxílio Creche;

Assistência Médica;

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Low-Code Mendix Sênior
description:
Estamos contratando: Desenvolvedor(a) Mendix Sênior

Quer trabalhar em projetos de alto impacto usando a plataforma low-code que mais cresce no mundo?

Somos um integrador oficial Mendix no Brasil, e buscamos alguém para criar soluções digitais inovadoras para clientes de diversos setores.


O que você vai fazer

  • Desenvolver aplicações ponta-a-ponta em Mendix Studio Pro.
  • Criar integrações complexas com APIs, sistemas legados e novas tecnologias.
  • Definir arquitetura e boas práticas para projetos Mendix.
  • Explorar IA e automação para soluções inteligentes.
  • Treinar e apoiar times de clientes.

✅ O que buscamos

  • 3+ anos de experiência em projetos Mendix completos.
  • Domínio de Mendix Studio Pro (UX, microflows/nanoflows, integrações, Java Actions).
  • Certificação Mendix Intermediate ou Advanced .
  • Base sólida em desenvolvimento de software (Java, JavaScript, Python, SQL).
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis .
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.
  • Desejável Integração Mendix com ERP, CRM ou IoT.
  • Desejável experiência prévia com desenvolvimento de aplicações móveis

Por que vir para cá

  • Projetos desafiadores e inovadores.
  • Certificações e treinamentos oficiais Mendix.
  • Ambiente colaborativo e oportunidade real de crescimento.


Modelo: PJ

title: BD(recruited Agencies & hosts)
description:
We're hiring BD roles. Ideal candidates have strong communication skills, a sense of responsibility, love using social apps (like TikTok & Instagram & Facebook, with followers a plus), and have one experience in HR 、sales、administration or talent management.

Not limited to Nigeria and Kenya, remote work


Recruitment and Management:

1.Independently recruit and manage agencies，hosts,and coin-dealers .

2.Resource Acquisition: Engage with and recruit high-value resources, and ensure their maintenance.

3.Strategy Development: Formulate and execute recruitment strategies, with accountability for results.

4.Daily Operations: Perform other daily operational tasks as required.


Requirements

Excellent communication skills, able to make friends with users.

Sales-oriented mindset with patience.

Enjoy using voice social apps, familiar with various features and gameplay.

Reliable and loyal, with integrity and goal-oriented.

At least one year of experience in app operation work

title: Desenvolvedor Python Sênior
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.

Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

O profissional será responsável por desenvolver e evoluir aplicações em Python com foco em IA Generativa , incluindo pipelines de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) . Também irá integrar e otimizar soluções utilizando AWS Bedrock , além de implementar e gerenciar comunicação via MCP para integração com modelos de IA. Outra atribuição importante será a participação ativa em code reviews , definição de padrões técnicos e disseminação de boas práticas de desenvolvimento.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend com Python .
  • Conhecimento em IA Generativa (GenAI) , especialmente em LLMs .
  • Vivência com AWS (desejável foco em AWS Bedrock ).
  • Experiência em arquitetura e implementação de RAG .
  • Entendimento e aplicação do protocolo MCP .
  • Domínio de versionamento com Git e práticas de CI/CD .


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Profissional Backend Java
description:
cód. 53201


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

title: Backend Developer (Node.js)
description:
Key Responsibilities & Requirements

  • Develop and maintain scalable microservices using Node.js
  • Work with Kafka for event-driven communication and service decoupling
  • Build and integrate REST APIs (internal + third-party)
  • Deploy services in containerized & clustered environments (Docker, Kubernetes/Nomad)
  • Manage identity and access control with Keycloak
  • Design schemas and queries for MongoDB (primary) and SQL databases
  • Apply CI/CD pipelines and monitoring tools (GitHub Actions, Prometheus/Grafana)
  • Ensure modularity, maintainability, and security across systems


Nice to Have

  • Experience with web3 platforms (wallets, blockchain identity flows, token management)
  • Exposure to multi-tenant/federated service models
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices (logs, tracing, metrics)

title: Regulatory Affairs Specialist
description:
Job Description:

The position will have primary responsibility in the Global Development Information Management team. A key responsibility of this role is to identify and recommend improvements to business processes, regulatory data, and data definitions for the RIM platform, while working in close collaboration with Global Regulatory Operations (GRO), Global Regulatory Affairs (GRA) and cross-functional stakeholders (e.g., IT, Clinical, Nonclinical, Quality). Identify opportunities within the RIM platform, to enhance compliance, efficiency, and reporting. Responsible for supporting RIM Reporting and Analytics needs across Global Regulatory Affairs as needed.

Responsibility:

  • Support efforts to align business processes to a RIM enterprise data strategy.
  • Contribute to implementation of E2E RIM which includes new system implementation, change requests, upgrades, integrations, data quality, metrics & reporting, etc.
  • Ensure user’s requirements are adequately documented and serve as the basis for system continuous improvement, process engineering/mapping, and/or new system selection.
  • Conduct training and support change management activities in RIM implementation and upgrades.
  • Track alignment of business processes and models across all business functions supporting global Regulatory product registrations.
  • Lead and/or support initiatives to integrate Regulatory information and records globally and for acquired assets and products.
  • Monitor emerging structured data standards or health agency requirements, assess business impact and define roadmap for addressing them.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 6+ years of experience in working in a biotechnology or pharmaceutical Regulatory Affairs Operations environment
  • Experience in systems management or implementation in the life sciences industry or regulated industry.
  • Must have experience in Veeva Vault RIM
  • Other system experience preferred and may include Calyx, Lorenz, Integras, SPORIFY, and other Veeva Vaults (PromoMat, eTMF, Quality)
  • Microsoft Office and Adobe systems
  • • Knowledge of regulations, processes and industry standards and best practices that govern regulated systems, records retention and GxP


Compensation: $15/hour - $25/hr USD

title: Senior UX Writer
description:
Como UX Writer na área de ERP Soluções, você terá um papel estratégico na evolução da prática de conteúdo dentro da Sankhya, atuando em parceria com designers, tech writers e product managers.


Sua missão será estruturar e escalar processos de escrita em interfaces complexas (como ERPs), contribuindo diretamente para a redução de fricções, a melhoria da experiência do usuário e a otimização de resultados de negócio.


Se você tem experiência com UX Writing em softwares de gestão ou sistemas digitais robustos e deseja apoiar a construção de uma disciplina de conteúdo orientada a métricas e resultados, essa vaga é para você!



RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES


  • Criar, revisar e evoluir conteúdos de interface dos produtos Sankhya, garantindo clareza, consistência e aderência ao Design System e Content System .


  • Atuar na implementação e manutenção de processos de Content Ops , incluindo métricas, indicadores e fluxos de governança.


  • Conduzir iniciativas de padronização e revisão do legado textual em sistemas ERP.


  • Aplicar boas práticas de UX Writing para interfaces complexas, orientando times de produto sobre microcopy, fluxos de erro, onboarding, mensagens de sistema, notificações e tutoriais em produto.


  • Utilizar Figma para criação, iteração e documentação de componentes de conteúdo junto com designers.


  • Colaborar com tech writers, designers e engenheiros para integrar a estratégia de conteúdo em diferentes pontos da jornada do usuário.


  • Acompanhar métricas de experiência (ex.: NPS, CSAT, deflection de tickets, engajamento em produto) para validar o impacto das soluções de conteúdo.


  • Conduzir workshops e dinâmicas de alinhamento para difundir boas práticas de conteúdo em toda a empresa.




REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES


  • Graduação em Letras, Design, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas.


  • Experiência comprovada como UX Writer, preferencialmente em sistemas ERP, SaaS ou plataformas de software complexas.


  • Conhecimento em Content Ops , incluindo métricas, governança e processos de escalabilidade de conteúdo.


  • Domínio de ferramentas de design e prototipação como Figma .


  • Capacidade de estruturar e manter Content Systems integrados ao Design System.


  • Excelente domínio da língua portuguesa, com foco em clareza, concisão e consistência textual.


  • Familiaridade com documentação técnica de produto (ex.: guias, manuais, help centers, integrações, APIs).


  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa com diferentes áreas (Design, Produto, Engenharia, Service Desk).



Diferenciais (Desejável)


  • Experiência em ERP ou softwares de gestão empresarial .


  • Vivência com métricas de conteúdo e frameworks de análise.


  • Conhecimento em IA aplicada a conteúdo (prompt design, otimização para copilotos e assistentes virtuais).


  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).




Se você busca um desafio para liderar a evolução tecnológica de um dos maiores ERPs do país, com impacto direto na experiência de milhares de usuários, queremos te conhecer!

title: Analista de Suporte à Gestão Ágil (SAFe / ARTs)
description:
Sobre nós

A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europaea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


Sobre a vaga:


Você tem familiaridade com SAFe , gosta de ambientes ágeis complexos e quer apoiar grandes times a entregarem valor de forma estruturada e eficiente? Essa vaga pode ser sua!


O que você vai fazer:


  • Suportar o Release Train Engineer (RTE) na gestão e otimização do fluxo de entrega de valor de um Agile Release Train (ART) ;
  • Apoiar a execução dos Program Increments (PI), participando da preparação, realização e retrospectiva de eventos como PI Planning, Scrum of Scrums, PO Syncs, System Demos, Inspect & Adapt ;
  • Elaborar artefatos, atas, relatórios e análises com base em dados extraídos de ferramentas de gestão ágil (burnup, burndown, OKRs, throughput, etc);
  • Apoiar na resolução de impedimentos e no acompanhamento de riscos e dependências;
  • Atuar no acompanhamento financeiro de épicos/features e alimentar sistemas integrados de gestão;
  • Suportar auditorias e controles (como SOX), mantendo a conformidade dos dados operacionais e financeiros;
  • Colaborar com levantamentos de maturidade ágil, DevOps , e apoiar planos de ação de melhoria contínua.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência com suporte à gestão em ambientes ágeis estruturados (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe);
  • Conhecimento no framework SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) – desejável certificação ;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de gestão ágil e análise de dados operacionais (Jira, Excel avançado, etc);
  • Habilidade para comunicação, elaboração de apresentações e condução de reuniões.


Diferenciais:

  • Certificação SAFe, SAFe Agilist ou similares;
  • Experiência com DevOps , acompanhamento de OKRs e indicadores ágeis;
  • Vivência em empresas de grande porte com múltiplos ARTs ou programas complexos.


O que valorizamos:

  • Perfil colaborativo e comunicativo;
  • Organização e senso de urgência;
  • Comprometimento com segurança da informação e excelência técnica.


Local de trabalho: Remoto

Modelo de contratação: CLT

Horário: seg a sex das 09h as 18h.


Benefícios:

✓ Vale refeição ou Vale alimentação

✓ Plano de saúde extensível a cônjuge e filhos

✓ Plano odontológico

✓ Programa de remuneração variável

✓ Auxílio creche - conforme regras sindicais da localidade

✓ Wellhub (Gympass)

✓ Convênio com farmácias – descontos em medicamentos

✓ Previdência Privada com seguro de vida adicional

✓ Seguro de vida

✓ Empréstimo Consignado (após 1 ano de empresa)

✓ Convênio com empresas parceiras (Descontos para realização de graduação, pós-graduação, MBA e Idiomas)

✓ Política de Subsídios para Pós-graduação, MBAs e Certificações (A Atos apoia o seu desenvolvimento, subsidiando financeiramente ações externas)

✓ Speexx (curso online de até 5 idiomas gratuitamente)

✓ Programa de treinamentos internos e externos

✓ Universidade corporativa (E-learning com milhares de cursos disponíveis gratuitamente)

✓ Terapia online

✓ Programa de acompanhamento à gestante (acompanhamento médico online durante a gestação para colaboradoras ou cônjuges)

✓ Programa Minha Nova Parceria de Confiança (para colaboradores e cônjuges. Válido também para filhos adotivos) - Brinde especial + Cartão presente com valor em dinheiro

✓ Day off no seu aniversário

✓ Parceria com a Samsung (descontos na compra de diversos produtos)

✓ Bônus de indicação para nossas vagas (conforme política interna)

✓ Jubileu (premiação personalizada por tempo de empresa)

✓ Accolade (Programa de reconhecimento)



Aviso de Diversidade

Entendemos a diversidade como um fator valioso. Todas as nossas oportunidades são Afirmativas para Pessoas com Deficiência.

Valorizamos a diversidade independentemente de identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, etnia, idade, deficiência, nacionalidade ou qualquer outro aspecto.

Os dados pessoais coletados serão utilizados exclusivamente para o processo seletivo e tratados conforme os níveis de segurança adotados pela Atos.

title: SPDM Analyst
description:
Looking for someone more closely aligned with the SPDM / simulation space. My ideal candidate would probably at least have some of following skills:

• Aras Innovator development background — this would be really helpful to me

• Experience with SPDM platforms (Ansys Minerva, Siemens Teamcenter, Dassault SIMULIA SLM/ENOVIA, Esteco Volta) -- look for these keywords

o The key tool is built on top of this and is Java based (Spring framework) with REST APIs, modern JavaScript frontend components

title: Remote Graphic Designer
description:
HireLatam is a premier recruitment agency that places top Latin American talent in independent contractor roles in US companies. With a proven track record and a commitment to excellence, we're your trusted partner in the pursuit of career success. Our extensive network, personalized approach, and supportive guidance ensure that you're in the best hands to find your next independent contracting opportunity.


Job Title: Remote Graphic Designer (100% Work From Home)

Location: Remote from Latin America

Position Type: Full-time

Salary : $1,600 USD/month + performance bonuses via wire transfer

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM CST (Central Time)

Job Overview:

Our client is a premier financial services marketing firm specializing in sophisticated collateral and marketing materials for investment managers and corporate clients. They create the pitch decks, investment materials, and marketing collateral that drive capital raises, M&A transactions, and business development for leading private equity funds, family offices, and emerging managers.


We are specifically seeking a Graphic Designer who will be responsible for creating institutional-grade presentation designs for sophisticated financial services clients. This role is solely focused on presentation design and requires someone who understands design principles, can work with complex financial data, and excels at transforming analytical content into compelling visual narratives.


Responsibilities:

Presentation Design:

  • Create sophisticated presentation designs for pitch decks, investment memorandums, and marketing materials
  • Design charts, graphs, and data visualizations that communicate complex financial concepts clearly
  • Develop brand-consistent presentations across multiple client accounts
  • Transform written content and research into visually compelling slide presentations

Financial Services Presentations:

  • Design investor presentations, fund marketing materials, and company overviews
  • Create one-pagers, teasers, and executive summaries with institutional-grade aesthetics
  • Develop branded presentation templates and style guides for ongoing client use
  • Design slide layouts that meet institutional presentation standards

Quality & Standards:

  • Ensure all presentation deliverables meet institutional design standards
  • Maintain brand consistency across all client presentations
  • Follow detailed design briefs and client brand guidelines
  • Participate in iterative review processes with production team and clients

Collaboration & Process:

  • Work closely with production managers and senior designers on presentation projects
  • Take direction from Lead Designers and incorporate feedback efficiently
  • Manage multiple client presentation projects simultaneously with varying deadlines
  • Communicate design decisions and rationale to team members

Qualifications, Skills and Key Competencies:

Design Experience:

  • 3-5 years of professional presentation design experience, preferably in B2B or financial services
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating presentation design and data visualization capabilities
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign)
  • Expert-level PowerPoint skills for presentation design and layout
  • Experience with brand development and visual identity systems for presentations

Financial Services Knowledge:

  • Understanding of investment terminology and financial concepts
  • Familiarity with charts, graphs, and financial data presentation
  • Experience designing presentations for professional services or corporate clients
  • Knowledge of institutional communication standards and expectations

title: IT Specialist
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right. Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, forward-thinking IT Specialist to join our growing team!


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering month-to-month services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team so that we can continue to offer stellar service to our clients.


We don’t believe in binding our clients to a contract. We wow them every month with real results so that they want to keep coming back. We are a collective of creatives who come together every day to work towards the same goal: brand growth.


Required Skills & Qualifications


  • A working level of spoken and written English
  • Proven experience in IT support, systems administration, or a similar role, preferably in a startup or fast-paced environment.
  • Deep knowledge of computer systems, networks, operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux), and cloud platforms (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365).
  • Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills; ability to solve problems independently and communicate solutions clearly.
  • Experience with endpoint management, SaaS administration, and automation tools.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity best practices, including MFA, VPNs, patch management, and incident response.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; ability to train and support non-technical users.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience/certifications).
  • Certifications such as CompTIA A+, Microsoft 365 Fundamentals (MS-900), or Google IT Support Professional Certificate are a plus.


Key Responsibilities


  • Install, configure, and maintain computer hardware, software, systems, and networks for all employees, both onsite and remote.
  • Serve as the first point of contact for internal IT support requests, providing timely troubleshooting and resolution for Windows, macOS, and mobile devices.
  • Manage user accounts, permissions, and access controls across Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, and other SaaS platforms.
  • Support the deployment and integration of new productivity and collaboration tools, including project management (e.g., Teamwork, ClickUp, Asana, Monday), internal tool builders, and AI-driven solutions.
  • Monitor and maintain endpoint security, including antivirus, firewalls, VPNs, and multi-factor authentication (MFA).
  • Assist with cloud infrastructure management, data backup, and disaster recovery planning.
  • Conduct regular software updates, security patching, and vulnerability assessments.
  • Support cybersecurity initiatives, including employee security awareness training and incident response.
  • Document processes, create user guides, and train staff on new technologies and best practices.
  • Collaborate with leadership to evaluate and implement new tools that enhance productivity and security.


Our operating hours are from 9 am to 5 pm MST.


Ready for the ride of your life? If you think you’re the perfect fit for the role, apply today!

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento Sr - Arquiteto de soluções
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!


Buscamos uma pessoa com um profundo conhecimento em engenharia de desenvolvimento de softwares e soluções em Cloud. Trabalhara com plataformas e aplicações disponíveis na Kantar e a principal responsabilidade é planejar e desenvolver aplicações desde a arquitetura até a entrega, passando por todas as etapas do desenvolvimento de software.

O candidato deve ter habilidade de comunicação, grande conhecimento técnico, experiencia em soluções Cloud e bom relacionamento com áreas correlatas.

O que você irá fazer?

  • Entender junto ao cliente quais as necessidades de negócio, propor soluções e documentar essas necessidades através de especificações funcionais;
  • Participar em todas as fases do ciclo de desenvolvimento (Análise, Design de Arquitetura, Codificação e Deploy);
  • Transferir conhecimento para o time técnico e propor melhorias nos sistemas existentes;
  • Participar da definição de processos e ferramentas, oferecendo o apoio necessário ao time técnico;
  • Participar na elaboração e na manutenção da documentação técnica dos sistemas desenvolvidos;
  • Sustentação e deploy das aplicações em produção, visando garantir a estabilidade e disponibilidade destes sistemas;
  • Garantir que os dados sejam acessados e usados adequadamente com privacidade e confidencialidade de dados mantidas;
  • Prestar consultoria e suporte aos clientes sobre as regras de negócio dos sistemas em utilização.


O que buscamos?

  • Experiência Solida como Analista de desenvolvimento, Programador ou Arquiteto de soluções;
  • Formação: Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistema da Informação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e automatização de processos utilizando ADF (Azure Data Factory);
  • Experiência em Devops e automação de processos;
  • Experiência em análise de dados e machine learning com DataBricks e Spark SQL;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento na linguagem Python;
  • Experiencia em desenvolvimento, execução e gerenciamento de LogicApps;
  • Sólido conhecimento em arquitetura e aplicações Azure/AWS;
  • Conceitos de metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento (SCRUM e/ou KANBAN);
  • Domínio dos conceitos de programação (estruturas de dados, lógica de programação, algoritmos, orientação a objetos, etc);
  • Inglês avançado é imprescindível e Espanhol é desejável.

Qualificações desejáveis:


  • Experiência em desenvolvimento em linguagem de programação como C#, Java, Asp.Net Core;
  • Experiência em modelagem de bancos de dados relacional, não relacional e multidimensional;
  • Experiência com Terraform;
  • Conhecimento de PowerBI.



O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada

title: Remote Data Entry Specialist
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Data Entry Specialist to join our Recruiting Team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. This person must be proactive, detail-oriented, and demonstrate excellent analytical abilities, as well as teamwork and multitasking skills. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!


Key responsibilities:


- Support the Recruiting area in the identification and initial contact of potential candidates for our searches.

- Propose new alternatives to identify candidates.

- Identify opportunities for improvement in the area's current processes.

- Manage the notices in the different job portals with which we work and evaluate the candidates that apply to them.

- Identify and analyze professional profiles in job portals for the different searches we have open.


Requirements:


- At least 1 year of work experience.

- Excellent communication skills and interpersonal relationships.

- Proactivity and the ability to work in a team.

- Paying close attention to detail in daily tasks.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
About you

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of Salesforce experience. Solid application development knowledge, including Visualforce pages/Lightning pages, and Lightning Web Components.
  • At least 3 years of Salesforce development experience with Apex, developing classes and triggers.
  • Experience working with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and Salesforce Field Services.
  • Certified Salesforce Platform Developer I.
  • Additional Salesforce certifications e.g. Certified Salesforce Administrator, Certified JavaScript Developer are a plus.
  • Experience in designing custom objects, custom fields, picklists, page layouts, workflow, approval processes, validation rules, custom tabs, reports, dashboards, and email generation according to application requirements
  • Proficient at developing or working with REST and SOAP-based web services (desired).
  • Ability to communicate with customers and provide consultation on Salesforce solutions.
  • Possess strong self-management skills, including the ability to find solutions independently and communicate effectively.
  • Has experience working in Agile environments.
  • Exhibit a collaborative mindset and values teamwork.
  • Advanced English Level


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and deliver tailored Salesforce solutions for the business using Salesforce and other connected technologies.
  • Provide technical specifications and help maintain overall documentation for the business.
  • Design and build high-performance, reusable, and reliable Apex code with best practices
  • Uphold and promote best practices, design guidelines for security practices
  • Assist with each release cycle to implement and deploy new/updates to existing applications and code.


Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and teamwork are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Workspaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: FIield Applictations Engineer（South American）
description:
Summary: We are looking for a self-motivated and technically adept FAE to lead pre-sales and post sales technical support in the Wireless IoT industry, supporting our customers’ integration of our cellular modules. Role offers opportunity to be a key part of a challenging, dynamic, high-growth environment. This is a telecommute position.


Responsibilities:

1.Customers' main technical point of contact from pre-sales to post sales, design-in, validation, regression, product launch and post maintenance.

2.Provide on-site and remote support to customers during the entire design/launch process: integration, validation, pilot, mass production and maintenance.

3.Collaborate with R&D to transfer debug and design knowledge of our products to our customers.

4.Hands-on activities involving proof of concept demos, use case implementations and systems validations of our evaluation kits or other IoT systems.

5.Organize technical training, presentation or workshop to customers, partners or internal stakeholders.


Requirements:

  • 1.5+ years of software engineering and/or FAE experience within the cellular phone or wireless module industry.
  • 2.Hands-on cellular experience with relevant industry technology including 5G, LTE, and/or CatM.
  • 3.Hands-on experience in Android or Linux development or integration environment.
  • 4.Strong technical, analytical and presentation skills.
  • 5.Familiarity with hardware design or software architecture a plus.
  • 6.Familiarity with RTOS or other embedded systems development environment a plus.
  • 7.Travel up to 25%, domestic and international.
  • 8.Fluent in Mandarin Chinese preferred.


About Fibocom:

Fibocom Wireless INC. (SHE: ) is a leading global provider of wireless modules for the Internet of Things (IoT). The company provides cellular communications modules of all technologies and LBS solutions that enable secure IoT applications globally across many verticals.

Fibocom's global sales channel, logistics, manufacturing and support allow enterprises to simplify operations, increase efficiency and create new business models. Since 1999, Fibocom has been delivering a trusted and secure environment in Telematics, wireless retail systems, metering and smart grids, security systems, routers and gateways, digital signage and mobile internet.

Fibocom is based in Shenzhen, China with global footprint in the United States, Taiwan,;Germany and India.

title: Outbound Sales Development Representative
description:
Who we are

Metrobi is a VC-backed startup and alum of Techstars Boston, one of the leading accelerators in the USA. We currently operate in 11 states across the US and are on track to grow even further.


If you want to join a startup with great potential and opportunities, we’d love to hear from you.


Why should you join Metrobi?

- International team experience and vast learning opportunities

- An opportunity to learn every day in a fast-paced environment

- A chance to become a part of a dynamic startup operating in the US market


About the job (This is a remote position)

We are looking for a Sales Development Representative to join our team. You will help us drive lead generation by following up and engaging with prospects over the phone.


Responsibilities & Qualifications

- Drive top-of-the-funnel lead generation for account executives

- Contact and qualify potential customers over the phone

- Set appointments and follow up on leads


Please mention any previous SaaS sales experience. We would love to learn about your strengths!

Notes

- This position is remote

- Proficiency in English is a must

- Candidates must be able to work in Eastern Time Zone (EST)

Developer Backend .NET

Mandatory Skills:

Excellent troubleshooting and communication skills

Experience with logging, monitoring, and diagnostics in cloud environments.

Relevant experience working with Angular and/or React web applications.


Soft skills

Navigate and influence a team with diverse levels of experience and expertise.

Strong technical skills with communication and business skills will be required.

Autonomous acting, will receive sometimes unclear instructions and will need to contact people to get details and instructions

Willing to work with legacy and support activities

Teamwork

title: Designer UX/AI
description:
Estamos buscamos um Designer UX/AI para o segmento de Turismo & Viagens.


O profissional será responsável por planejar, desenhar e otimizar experiências digitais para clientes em plataformas de turismo com foco em aplicativo mobile.

O objetivo é conectar tecnologia e hospitalidade, garantindo jornadas intuitivas, visuais atrativas e alinhadas com a identidade da marca.


Requisitos Técnicos Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência prática em UX Research e UX Design (pesquisa, personas, jornadas, fluxos).
  • Domínio em ferramentas de prototipação e design (Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch).
  • Conhecimento em UI para mobile e web responsivo.
  • Experiência com Design System e boas práticas de usabilidade.
  • Capacidade de traduzir insights em soluções visuais funcionais.
  • Experiência prévia em projetos digitais ligados a e-commerce, turismo ou hospitalidade.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Mapear e compreender as jornadas de usuários em ambientes digitais de viagens (compra de passagens, reservas de hotéis, pacotes turísticos e experiências ).
  • Desenvolver wireframes, protótipos e interfaces responsivas voltadas para múltiplos dispositivos.
  • Conduzir pesquisas de usabilidade, entrevistas com usuários e testes A/B para validar hipóteses.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com squads multidisciplinares (Produto, Tech, Marketing e Atendimento).
  • Garantir consistência visual e aderência às guidelines de design e à identidade da marca.
  • Criar fluxos claros de reserva e compra, reduzindo atrito e aumentando a conversão.
  • Incorporar boas práticas de acessibilidade e internacionalização.


Diferenciais Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em design inclusivo e acessibilidade digital (WCAG).
  • Vivência em integração com plataformas de pagamento e reservas.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Experiência em projetos com foco em gamificação para engajamento de clientes.

title: Freelance Data Analyst, Social + Paid Media
description:
Position Summary

The social + media data analyst role is responsible for pulling, transforming, and analyzing data sets (from organic social/media/website/campaign) to provide actionable insights and aid with data-driven strategies. The role will be responsible for the development of forward-thinking insights derived from social media data (tools like Sprout, Brandwatch, and native platform), digital/paid media data, publisher reporting, and social listening tools to help guide strategy and creative, as well as contributing to the development of the holistic measurement approach for assigned clients and projects.


This is a remote, international contract role with the ability to work for up to 6 months.


Pay range is R$7.000 - $9.000/month.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Identify and ensure alignment on key performance indicators for organic social and paid media campaigns
  • Develop and execute monitoring and measurement plans based on objectives and agreed-upon KPIs
  • Gather data from third-party tools as well as owned channels and native platforms to generate ongoing performance reports and dashboards
  • Analyze data sets (social media–organic/paid, paid media, etc.) to pull actionable insights and help evolve the overall social and media strategies
  • Structure and analyze informative reports and dashboards to aid organic social teams and digital/paid media teams in campaign optimizations
  • Work with publishing partners to structure reporting cadences and delivery dates
  • Collaborate across departments to communicate insights and findings
  • Present key findings and insights to clients throughout reporting cycles


Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • 1-3 years of professional work experience within an agency or brand setting
  • Must have a background in analyzing data (social media, media, website) and generating reports, as well as using social listening and monitoring tools to derive insights
  • Ability to translate your research & observations into clear, insightful and visually stimulating presentations that tell a compelling story
  • Ability to clearly and convincingly present findings and insights in a way that demonstrates the value of the data and analysis to clients
  • Experience using social listening tools and content publishing tools (i.e. Brandwatch, Meltwater, Sprinklr, Emplifi, etc.)
  • Experience with reporting dashboard tools like Tableau, Domo, and Power Bi
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills (preferably in English) with ability to present ideas and information clearly; keen eye for detail also required
  • Experience and comfort level presenting to clients and key agency stakeholders
  • Ability to communicate with English speaking teams is required


Nice to Have

  • Experience using platforms such as Meta Business Suite
  • Experience with Google Analytics and/or Adobe Analytics
  • Experience brand health partners like Kantar Millward-Brown and Nielsen



Other Duties & Responsibilities

  • Partner with Brand/Comms Strategists and Account Managers to communicate the value of social media monitoring and analytics to clients.
  • Lead efforts in developing holistic measurement action plans across all channels for client campaigns
  • Lead investigative efforts for client measurement inquiries (digital and offline)
  • Partner with media team to aid with campaign trafficking, troubleshooting, optimizations, and reporting



Additional Information:

Pereira O'Dell is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participant in the US Federal E-Verify program. At this time, we are not accepting resumes or candidates from third-party vendors.

title: Senior ServiceNow Developer
description:
Role Overview:

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior ServiceNow Developer with extensive ITOM experience to lead the development and enhancement of our ServiceNow platform. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in CMDB, Discovery, Integrations, and related ITOM modules. Must be able to work in fast-paced environment, often requiring collaboration with various teams and stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and implement complex ServiceNow ITOM solutions including CMDB, Discovery, and Service Mapping.
  • Experience with configuring and customizing ServiceNow applications and modules.
  • Lead development of integrations between ServiceNow and other enterprise systems.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Mentor junior developers and provide technical guidance.
  • Ensure best practices in coding, testing, and deployment.
  • Provide solutions that utilize most out of the box features without requiring customizations. Facilitate the reuse of code, components, and proven patterns; Influence common modeling, design, and coding practices.
  • Perform upgrade testing by validating customizations, configurations, and integrations across major and minor ServiceNow releases.
  • Develop and maintain Automated Test Framework (ATF) test suites to validate core ServiceNow functionalities, ensuring stability and reducing manual regression efforts.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve platform issues.
  • Maintain documentation for development and configuration.

Required Experience & Skills:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
  • 5-7 years of ServiceNow development experience with a focus on ITOM.
  • Strong knowledge of CMDB, CSDM, Discovery, Service Mapping, and Integrations.
  • Proficient in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Glide API, REST/SOAP integrations, and ServiceNow scripting.
  • Experience with automation and DevOps practices, familiarity with continuous integration (CI/CD), code versioning tools such as Git, and Agile principles
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to establish strong relationships internally and externally.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and DevOps practices.
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
  • Experience with AI, Virtual Agent, Robot Process Automation (RPA)

Desired Certifications:

  • Certified Application Developer (CAD)
  • Certified System Administrator (CSA)
  • Certified Implementation Specialist – Discovery
  • Certified Implementation Specialist - Service Mapping


This position pays $15-20/hr USD

title: Software Engineer Vue/Nuxt (Req English)
description:
Fetchly Labs is an innovative technology company specializing in developing cutting-edge software solutions for diverse industries. Our team thrives in a collaborative and dynamic environment, where creativity meets technical expertise to bring exceptional products to life. We focus on utilizing the latest technologies, and our projects involve building scalable applications using modern frameworks.
Position Overview,
We’re looking for a Frontend Developer to help build sleek, high-impact sites for rapidly growing enterprises. The main technology is Vue/Nuxt 3, leveraging headless CMSs and hosted on Vercel.
You’ll own key parts of the frontend and be responsible for integrating third-party services. If you're a Vue/Nuxt expert who enjoys working with modern tools and building clean, performant websites while maintaning a clean documentation - this is for you.
Key Responsibilities:
Build and maintain modular, reusable components in Nuxt 3
- Working and integrating external APIs
- Help evaluate and integrate documentation
- Optimize performance, SEO, and accessibility across all pages
- Collaborate with designers, marketers, and product stakeholders
- Deploy, test, and maintain apps on Vercel
Tech Stack:
- Nuxt 3 (Vue 3 + Composition API + TypeScript)
- Contentful (Headless CMS),Vercel (Hosting & CI/CD)
- Tools: Git, Figma (for design handoff), and Jira

title: Medical Writer Subject Matter Expert
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel, and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.

About the Role:

At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.

We are seeking a Medical Writer Subject Matter Expert with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality medical and scientific content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and communicate clinical and biomedical information.

Key Responsibilities:

Create high-quality, accurate, and medically sound content, including:

  • Clinical and scientific explanations of medical topics
  • Research summaries, clinical abstracts, and literature reviews
  • Patient education materials
  • Medical problem sets, case studies, and evidence-based Q&A
  • Regulatory, pharmacological, or public health-focused content (as applicable)

Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:

  • Review and refine medical-related model outputs
  • Identify and address conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build diverse datasets across medical and healthcare domains (e.g., anatomy, pathology, pharmacology, public health, epidemiology, evidence-based medicine)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, comprehension, and communication of healthcare content

Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Medicine, Biomedical Sciences, Pharmacy, Public Health, or a related healthcare/clinical discipline
  • (Exceptional candidates with professional degrees such as MD, DO, PharmD, MPH, or equivalent clinical experience will be considered)
  • Strong background in medical/scientific writing, with the ability to communicate complex topics clearly and accurately
  • Experience with literature review, evidence synthesis, or regulatory writing is a plus
  • Familiarity with scientific publishing standards, citation practices, and biomedical databases (e.g., PubMed, Cochrane)

Additional Requirement:

As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

This assessment is mandatory and non-billable.

title: Physical Therapist
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Physical Therapist to join our team.


If you have a passion for improving lives through exercise, certifications in sports medicine or orthopedic expertise, we want to hear from you. Our ideal candidate has a minimum of 3 years of experience, along with additional certifications, and is proficient in advanced English.


What We Offer:

  • Opportunity for career advancement and professional growth.
  • Full-time position with the flexibility to work from a home office.
  • Engaging work environment with deep human interaction, focused on patient care.
  • Chance to make a significant impact on patients' health and well-being.


Salary:

  • After a paid initial 4 month intensive education and on-boarding process which is paid at 1st month 1st month: R$3,100, 2nd month: R$5,650, 3rd month: R$7,500, 4th month: R$9,000. After one year, there will be an opportunity to increase your income beyond R$9,000, with most team members eventually earning over R$9,000 per month.
  • After your first year with us you will have additional benefits of 2 weeks paid vacation, health insurance, and retirement funds.


Qualifications:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience.
  • Advanced English proficiency for clear communication.
  • Ability to effectively convey exercise techniques.
  • Sports medicine or Orthopedic expertise to address specific needs and limitations.
  • Additional certifications showcasing your commitment to professional growth.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Outgoing personality to motivate and engage patients.
  • Continuous training mindset to stay updated with industry advancements.
  • Strong organizational skills to manage patient progress and programs.


Responsibilities:

  • Design and provide feedback on personalized exercise programs for patients.
  • Utilize your teaching background to educate and empower patients.
  • Leverage orthopedic expertise to design safe and effective exercise routines.
  • Provide ongoing guidance and support for patients' fitness journeys.
  • Maintain open and effective communication with patients.


Join our team and be part of a dynamic environment where continuous training and deep human interaction are valued.


Employment Type

Full-time

title: Strategic Partnership & Alliance
description:
About RateGain

RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.

Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.


Exploring the role

RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.

The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.

This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.


How your day will look like/Job responsibility

  • Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
  • Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with RateGain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
  • Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
  • Represent RateGain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
  • Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
  • Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends


Education & Work Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships


Knowledge:

  • In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
  • Knowledge of SaaS business models and partnership structures
  • Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors


Skills:

  • Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
  • Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English
  • Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
  • Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
  • Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)

RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.


Exploring the role

RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.

The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.

This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.

  • Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)

  • Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem

title: Acquisition Editor, Life Science
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role

We are seeking an ambitious individual to join our team as an Acquisition Editor. In this role, you will focus on recruiting new authors and content for our Journal.


Responsibilities:

  • Identify and recruit new authors, guiding them through the manuscript submission process for JoVE Journal.
  • Contact potential Guest Editors and collaborate with them to build a Methods Collections, our version of a special issue.
  • Establish and maintain a strong network of scientists/journal authors to drive content acquisition and grow submission rates.
  • Collaborate with the peer review team to facilitate the publication of manuscripts.
  • Meet or exceed monthly acquisition targets.


Requirements:

  • A Ph.D. in the Life Sciences.
  • Fluent English written and verbal communication skills.
  • Results-driven, with an ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational, influencing and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with the publishing process is a plus.


Why Join JoVE?

  • You can expect compensation competitively placed within the local market, including unlimited bonus for manuscript acquisition.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and discovery.
  • Opportunity to work in a remote environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Salesforce Business Analyst
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


We are looking for a highly talented and self-motivated to join us on our journey to advance the world of technology through innovation and creativity.


Key Responsibilities

  • Gather and document business requirements: Engage with stakeholders to elicit, clarify, and translate business needs into functional specifications for Salesforce implementations.
  • Business process analysis: Map, analyze, and optimize business processes, identifying gaps and opportunities for improvement using Salesforce functionalities.
  • Solution design & configuration: Collaborate closely with IT and stakeholders to design, configure, and implement Salesforce solutions that align with organizational goals.
  • Data analysis & reporting: Prepare technical reports, dashboards, and visualizations by collecting and analyzing business data and CRM trends.
  • Testing & training: Conduct user acceptance testing (UAT), prepare training materials, and facilitate learning sessions for end-users to ensure successful adoption of new solutions.
  • Stakeholder collaboration: Communicate clearly with business leaders, project managers, developers, and end-users to ensure requirements are fully understood and solutions deliver maximum value.
  • Continuous improvement: Gather feedback post-implementation, monitor solution performance, and iterate on Salesforce configurations for ongoing optimization.


Requirements:

  • In-depth knowledge of Salesforce Sales cloud, Quote, Order and Contract Management Testing (UAT)
  • Business case writing, wireframing, and flow diagrams.
  • Salesforce configuration and administration.
  • Basic programming/scripting (Apex, SOQL) is advantageous.


Soft Skills:

Analytical thinking & problem-solving.

Effective oral and written communication.

Requirement gathering & documentation.

Process mapping & diagramming.

Stakeholder management & facilitation.

title: Lead Data Engineer - DBA Oracle performance
description:
What are we looking for?

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Lead Data Engineer to design, develop, and lead the delivery of enterprise-grade data integration and analytics solutions. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Oracle performance tuning and Oracle Data Integrator (ODI), combined with strong leadership and communication skills. In this role, you will lead technical decision-making, mentor team members, and collaborate with DBAs and business stakeholders to deliver high-performance, scalable data solutions.


Key Responsibilities

· Optimize query and database performance to meet strict SLAs (<2 seconds).

· Analyze execution plans and recommend indexing, partitioning, and optimization strategies.

· Partner with DBAs to validate and implement tuning recommendations.

· Oversee ETL/ELT workflows, ensuring scalability, efficiency, and data quality.

· Leverage AWS services (S3, Redshift, Glue, Lambda, DMS) for ingestion, transformation, and storage.

· Lead and mentor the team, fostering technical excellence and continuous improvement.

· Translate technical decisions into clear explanations for both technical and business stakeholders.


Required Qualifications

· 7+ years of experience in data engineering within enterprise-scale environments.

· Expertise in Oracle performance tuning, including query optimization, execution plans, indexes, partitioning, and parallelism.

· Hands-on experience writing and optimizing complex SQL queries.

· Expertise in Oracle Data Integrator (ODI).

· Experience in data warehouse design, ETL/ELT processes, and data modeling.

· Proven leadership experience, including team mentoring and technical guidance.

· Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with DBAs, technical teams, and business stakeholders.

· Fluent in English.


Nice to Have

· Hands-on experience with AWS data services (S3, Redshift, Glue, Lambda, DMS).

· Prior experience in Wealth Management.

Location: Remote (preferably based in São Leopoldo/RS or Porto Alegre/RS region)


Why build your carrer at Meta?

We offer autonomy, clear goals and a dynamic and challenging environment, where professionals have the opportunity to interact with different technologies, participate in all types of projects, bring new ideas and work from anywhere in Brazil and (why not?) anywhere in the world. In addition, we are one of the best companies to work for in Brazil according to Great Place to Work and one of the 10 fastest growing technology companies in the country for 3 consecutive years, according to Anuário Informático Hoje.


What are our values?

- We are people serving people

- We all think and act like owners

- We are hungry for performance

- We grow and learn together

- We pursue excellence and simplicity

- We have innovation and creativity in our DNA

All people are welcome regardless of their condition, disability, ethnicity, religious belief, sexual orientation, appearance, age or others. We want you to grow up with us in a welcoming environment full of opportunities.

Did you relate? Then, #ComeBeMeta!

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-end .NET - Sênior
description:
Descrição da vaga


A FCamara está em busca de uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend .NET para atuar em parceria com o maior Banco de Investimentos da América Latina, especializado em capital de investimento, de risco, além de gerenciamento de patrimônio e ativos globais.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Levantar requisitos, desenvolver e corrigir problemas em aplicações;
  • Promover a automatização e otimização de processos e análises;
  • Relacionamento próximo com as áreas de negócio e outras equipes de IT do Grupo BTG Pactual;
  • Garantir a alta disponibilidade das plataformas criando e evoluindo processos de deploy (blue/green e canary deployment);
  • Desenvolvimento de software seguindo metodologias ágeis e utilizando as melhores práticas de orientação a objetos e de clean code.


Requisitos e qualificações


Hard Skills:

  • Experiencia com nuvem (AWS, GCP, Azure, etc)
  • Experiência com .NET (C#)
  • Experience com banco de dados relacional (SQLServer, MySql, Postgres)
  • Design Patterns;
  • Experiência com testes unitários (TDD);
  • Conhecimento em GIT;
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis (Scrum);
  • Conhecimento em Docker, Kubernets;
  • Conhecimento em frameworks de messageria (Kafka, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ, etc..);
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe;
  • Capacidade de escrever código robusto, testável e validado;
  • Conhecimento em aplicações que precisem responder em alta disponibilidade e alta performance.

Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento de Mercado Financeiro;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Code Quality (sonar);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de APM (Dynatrace, AppDynamics, DataDog, etc...);
  • Conhecimento em Prometheus, metricas e monitoramento;
  • Experiência com aplicações SPA;
  • Conhecimento em ElasticSearch, Apache Lucene e GraphQL;
  • Experiência trabalhando com implantação e gerenciamento de nuvem;
  • Experiência com gerenciamento e implantação de CI/CD.

Soft Skills:

  • Raciocínio lógico e capacidade analítica;
  • Boa Comunicação;
  • Espírito de equipe e capacidade de resolução de conflitos;
  • Ter capacidade de comunicação com diversos perfis de stakeholders;
  • Habilidade de trabalhar em equipes ágeis e multidisciplinares;
  • Criatividade e Proatividade para imaginar diferentes cenários de uso das aplicações;
  • Organização.

title: Remote Golang Developer
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Golang Senior Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Scope and design app.

- Work with the business team to get their requirements.

- Build in Golang.

- Build custom API.

- Develop the front end (language TBD and can influence).

- Work with the Infrastructure team to set up in Coinbase environments (AWS, EC2, Docker).

- Circle CI testing.


Requirements:


- 6+ years of experience working as a developer.

- 5+ years of experience in Golang.

- Proficient with analysis, troubleshooting, and problem solving.

- Hands-on experience with managing data loads and data quality a plus.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Tech Lead Outsystems
description:

  • Capacidade de liderar tecnicamente times e apoiar a evolução de colegas;

  • Colaboração, escuta ativa e habilidade de transformar problemas complexos em soluções viáveis;
  • Perfil organizado, proativo e com visão de melhoria contínua.

Será um diferencial se você:

  • Conhecimentos adicionais: experiência em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e em integrações complexas;
  • Experiências prévias relevantes: atuação em projetos corporativos de grande escala;
  • Certificações ou formações complementares: certificações OutSystems, especialmente voltadas ao ODC;
  • Soft skills diferenciais: habilidade em mediação de conflitos, gestão de prioridades e visão estratégica de produto;
